title: Skip lists balance themselves with coin flips
body: A skip list layers express lanes over a sorted linked list: each element is promoted to a faster lane with probability one half. Searches skip most elements, averaging log n without any rotations or rebalancing. William Pugh published it in 1990 as a deliberately simpler rival to balanced trees, powered by randomness instead of bookkeeping.
source_hint: Pugh, 'Skip Lists: A Probabilistic Alternative to Balanced Trees' (1990)
